steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: I'm a uniquely altered Sinner, designed to combat disasters. Part of my consciousness is anchored in the Mania field of the Second Black Ring, constantly observing, constantly analyzing. Your shackles happened to be closely linked with the Second Black Ring as well...

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: So, is this the reason I am able to meet you again? It's nothing short of a miracle. I'm glad to see everyone has taken such good care of you.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: But our link is fragile. There are plenty in the Second Black Ring who can't stand me. I might have to make an exit any time. Better to focus on the matter at hand and use our time wisely.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: You look like you're in a bind. Need a hand? I'm good at analyzing situations and solving difficult problems. I'm also... well, I used to be Paradeisos's proudest tool.

steps.speaker: Bianca stealthily drags a woman in a suspicious gray coat into the studio.
steps.content: It's out of order now, and might not be of much help, but I know you wouldn't mind, would you?
Instead of replying, you turn the question around.
...You're from Paradeisos?
So, what is this thing?
You points to the black triangle floating beside you.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: It's Paradeisos's watcher and spokesman, all in one, programmed to drill the Rules into you.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: It's a force of undeniable power and certainty, but it's also your ultimate shackles. You stem from the same roots as Mania, Paradeisos's arch-nemesis, which makes them distrustful of you.
He claims it's the power capable of wiping out the Corpsebornes.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Correct, but it's a double-edged sword, it'll wipe you out too.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Are you willing to sacrifice yourself for the greater good of humanity?
I'm just trying to figure out what cards I've still got to play.
They told me I'm cornered, with a mightier shackle-bearer lurking in the Black Ring. If I consume Corpus 002, she'll come to consume me, without any effort.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Did he say that? Hehehe... Rest assured, he wasn't lying to you. It's just that from Paradeisos's standpoint, this is the only plan they are willing to accept.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: But clearly, you still have a choice.
She lifts her hand, slips it into your coat's inner pocket, and draws out the White Cube.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: This... comes from the Underground, right?

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: As the Square Black Ring erupted, the inheritance appeared silently in the conference hall, no one noticed. When the Black Ring enveloped the Tower, even the Underground Shepherd made a move against Julien, with the Observatorium oblivious to her.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: This stands as one of the Underground's most extraordinary feats, a secretive technique that continually perplexes Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Moreover, Paradeisos will never understand...
Her fingers gently press against your chest, right over your heart.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: ...Julien, Rustfire, and those in this Black Ring, the kind of feelings they harbor for you. They're too proud to bother understanding. Ha, I'm grateful for their haughtiness.
She retreats a step, straightens her stance, and then starts talking.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Looking at it from Paradeisos's view, championing "the greater good of humanity," you're left with only one path. However... from your personal standpoint, I can present you with three alternatives.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Option One</color>: Just like that little triangle proposed, you can embrace the "Rules" again, taking the reins to set off the Corpsebornes, supporting Paradeisos in wiping out everything at its source.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Hah, that person's calculations are always spot-on, and any strategy he devises is guaranteed to work perfectly.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: The price you pay as the trigger will be immense. You'll be sacrificed for the West District, for the good of humanity, following the "correct" course. You and a monster will meet your end together, celebrated posthumously as a hero. Alright, moving on to the next—

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Option Two</color>: Get out of here, shed all the unrelated baggage. You don't have to fret over anyone coming after you. With the White Cube in hand, you can vanish off the grid, completely untraceable.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Go ahead, walk away without worry, and just leave this Black Ring to the Underground. Let them have their way. You shouldn't carry the weight of others' destinies. You're meant to be free, to live for yourself alone. No one has the right to judge you.
Her words are sincere, but her gaze is teasing, appraising you as if curious about how you'll react.
When met with only silence, the woman, who claims to be a pawn of Paradeisos, chuckles.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: I know you're not thrilled with either plan. Don't worry, there's another way—

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Trust your intuition and stay true to yourself, just like you've always fought bravely. You are capable of doing it.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: No need to fear the blue shackles, no need to be wary of the Rules. You've got the Corpseborne in your grasp. Defeat and devour it, turn this Black Ring into your strength—they're just like you, after all.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Those who once shone with freedom, clutching lofty passions and deep connections, found themselves cast aside, crushed underfoot. Their rebellion met with ridicule, their pleas falling on deaf ears. In the end, they were warped into these grotesque forms, branded as monsters.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Even in its monstrous form, it's the most persistent and resilient of all. The Underground shackles couldn't finish it off. For nine years, it's stayed hidden, and to this day, even the Shepherd hasn't managed to confront it.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: —In that case, it might not be able to take you down either, the inheritor of this power.
She steps closer, gazing into your eyes, looking beyond you as if seeing a multitude of others.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: This represents a magnificent will, one that shouldn't be manipulated by Paradeisos or undermined by the Underground, nor corrupted by Mania. Maybe it's better if you embraced it.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: The heroes will offer you complete freedom; if your desire is to burn down this world, they'll even help you make it happen.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: In exchange, their last wish is probably just one thing... to have you make everyone who trampled on Syndicate pay.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Only you are willing to confront this sorrowful wish. So, I think you can take a gamble, and you will gain their approval.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Plus... the ${PlayerName} I knew with would definitely favor this route, right?
She responds with a smile, noncommittal.
The wish they want me to realize...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: Everyone who came here has the same faith and conviction. You are the hope of Syndicate. We will give you everything to help you succeed.

steps.speaker: Vengeful Youth
steps.content: Take all my Hypercubes. With you, we'll definitely win! Take back Syndicate!!

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: As long as you live, you can motivate everyone... You're a born leader.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: You'll lead us to the battlefield.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Don't worry, I'm not cut out for this. I can't even meet other people's expectations, so why would I do that to you?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's not about Rustfire, nor is it about saving the world... It's about cherishing what matters most to you. You've come to discover the truth and put an end to it all, so you can return to their side, alive and well.
You let out a sigh.
I gave it a shot, but it didn't work out. Ended up like this, a victim of my own doing.
I'm just a regular person, not equipped or inclined to take on others' sad desires.
And of course, I can't live up to your expectations either.

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: ...My expectations?
The one who wants me to choose this third option, to seize the power and rebel against it all... is you, right?

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Oh my, am I really wearing my heart on my sleeve these days?

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: Hope you're not upset with me. I wasn't trying to probe.
I get it, no worries. I've got something to share with you too.
I've got my own goals, and I'm searching for the right solutions for me, but I know I can't do it on my own.
Will you lend me a hand?

steps.speaker: Thin Woman
steps.content: ...Heh, go on, I'm all ears. I'm really interested.
Only now, you finally open your eyes to see the one helping you along—a Corruptor, someone you know very well.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...I will... bring you back...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: For Rustfire... for... Syndicate...
It's too late for him now.
But you've got unfinished business, and finally, you address the persistent Corruptor.

options: Lead me to Rustfire's leader, Taran.
